text:
### 1 — Scene
A mixed buffet-style meal: what appears to be a small roasted lamb shank, two mini egg/cheese tarts, sliced tofu, a fresh vegetable spring roll, and two tuna nigiri. The shank and tarts are the least certain identifications.

### 2 — Vessel
A shallow dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** in diameter.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
- Roasted lamb meat on a visible bone
- Two mini egg/cheese tarts
- Brown, firm tofu slices
- One fresh vegetable spring-roll piece
- Two tuna nigiri, including their rice

No separate sauce or pooled oil is clearly visible; cooking fat is included in the food energy estimates.

### 4–6 — Area, volume, and weight
The food covers approximately **46%** of the plate; exposed bone adds roughly another **3%**. The remaining plate is uncovered. Heights below are average thicknesses, not maximum heights.

| Food | Plate area | Area, cm² | Height, cm | Gross volume, ml | Density, g/ml | Estimated grams |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Lamb meat, excluding bone | 10% | 53 | 2.0 | 106 | 0.95 | 101 |
| Two mini tarts | 11% | 58 | 2.0 | 116 | 0.90 | 105 |
| Tofu slices | 8% | 42.5 | 2.0 | 85 | 0.95 | 81 |
| Vegetable spring roll | 7% | 37 | 1.8 | 67 | 0.65 | 43 |
| Two tuna nigiri | 10% | 53 | 1.7 | 90 | 0.95 | 86 |

Only the listed bulk-density factor is applied. The inedible bone is excluded from the edible weight estimate.

### 7 — Energy
| Food | kcal per 100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|
| Roasted lamb | 250 | 253 |
| Mini egg/cheese tarts | 280 | 294 |
| Tofu | 140 | 113 |
| Vegetable spring roll | 100 | 43 |
| Tuna nigiri | 145 | 125 |

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **416 g of edible food and 828 kcal** is plausible for these visible portions. The two nigiri account for only about 86 g, and the small spring-roll piece about 43 g. Identification of the tarts and bone-in item is the main source of uncertainty.
